description: A shell script that collects system memory, CPU, disk, and swap usage statistics, logs top output, and sends telemetry data if certain conditions are met.

methods.name: t2ValNotify
methods.description: Sends telemetry data to the telemetry client if it exists.

methods.name: getDate
methods.description: Returns the current date and time in 'YYYY:MM:DD:HH:MM:SS' format.

methods.name: getDateTime
methods.description: Returns the current date and time with nanoseconds in 'YYYY-MM-DD:HH:MM:SS:6N' format.

methods.name: extract
methods.description: Extracts a specific field from a string based on delimiter 'x'.

methods.name: change
methods.description: Calculates the difference between two CPU stat readings.
